grain.note: The approved look (round 9). Levels are set per surface, then the whole is scaled by grain-overall, so buildings show 45% on screen. Each surface writes its level as it is drawn; the grain pass applies it once, fixed to the screen, faded by distance. Same in every district.

tokens.name: grain-overall
tokens.usage: Scales every level below.

tokens.name: grain-white
tokens.usage: Buildings, pavements, the bottom corners, outer lanes and the road beyond about 18 m (45% on screen).

tokens.name: grain-cab
tokens.usage: A broad soft oval of road round the taxi, fading out between about 13 and 18 m ahead (about 11% on screen).

tokens.name: grain-sky
tokens.usage: The sky (30% on screen).

tokens.name: grain-people
tokens.usage: The ghosted people on the pavements (45% on screen).

tokens.name: grain-taxi
tokens.usage: The player's taxi (about 11% on screen).

tokens.name: grain-vehicles
tokens.usage: Other traffic (about 11% on screen).

tokens.name: grain-signs
tokens.usage: Signs and lights: never grained.

picture.note: Fixed numbers of the street picture and its meter.

tokens.name: picture-height
tokens.usage: The street is drawn for a 540-line picture; its width follows the window (960 at 16:9, 1170 on a 2.17:1 phone), and the picture is scaled to fill.

tokens.name: meter-scale
tokens.usage: The meter is drawn at 82.5% of its round 9 size, shrunk towards its bottom-left corner (Barney, 28 October 2026).

tokens.name: meter-inset
